question: In April 2021, Nethra Kumanan became the first Indian woman ever to qualify for the Olympics in__________________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sailing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Nethra Kumanan is the first Indian woman sailor to qualify for the Olympics.**
 
• The first among the **10 Indian sailors**, including **men **to have done so directly and by placing first in a **qualifying event **for the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• **The nine Indians **before her **managed **to get to **the Games **only because the quotas were not filled up.
 
• Earlier in **January 2020**, **Nethra Kumanan **became the **first Indian woman **to **win a bronze medal **at the **Hempel Sailing World Cup Series**, in Miami, U.S.A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sport of **sailing **involves a **variety of competitive sailing formats **that are sanctioned through various **sailing federations **and **yacht clubs**.
 
• **Racing disciplines **include **matches **within **a fleet of sailing craft**, between a **pair thereof, or among **teams.
 
• **The modern pentathlon **is an **Olympic sport **consisting of **fencing, freestyle swimming, equestrian show jumping, pistol shooting, and cross country running**. The event is **inspired by **the **traditional pentathlon held during the ancient Olympics**.
 
• Fencing is a **group of three related combat sports**. The **three disciplines **in modern **fencing are the foil **and the sabre; winning points are made through the **weapon's **contact with an **opponent**.
